content.short: T Minus One is a decentralized launchpad and token creator platform for secure new Cardano initiatives.
content.description: T Minus One (T-1) is a specialized launchpad and development platform designed to streamline the tokenization process on the Cardano blockchain. The platform provides a suite of trustless tools for token minting, vesting, and conducting Initial Token Offerings (ITOs). By utilizing automated smart contracts for post-sale liquidity management, T-1 ensures a secure and transparent environment for both founders and investors. Additionally, the project features unique NFT call options, allowing users to hedge their positions and trade sophisticated derivatives within the growing DeFi ecosystem.
